name.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値
name.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds

caption.ja: 長さ17・32の小信号に3段Haar分解を適用。1標本シフトと奇数長の境界処理を分けて比較します。 保存配列から作図。 標本添字は物理空間の座標ではありません。境界処理を含む有限長信号の写像です。
caption.en: Apply three-level Haar analysis to short signals of lengths 17 and 32, separating one-sample shifts from odd-length boundary handling. Drawn from saved arrays. Sample indices are not physical spatial coordinates. This is a finite-signal map with declared boundary handling.

name.ja: 有限長信号の離散Haar変換
name.en: Discrete Haar transforms of finite signals

note.ja: 奇数長の追加標本と切戻しを含む有限写像です。冗長拡張全体の直交性は仮定しません。
note.en: A finite map including odd-length padding and cropping; global orthogonality is not assumed for redundant extensions.

equation_note.ja: 奇数長の各段で周期型は先頭、対称型は末尾を1点追加し、再構成時に切り戻します。詳細係数のみ閾値0.2を使用。
equation_note.en: At each odd-length level append the first sample for periodic extension or the last for symmetric extension, then crop during synthesis. Apply threshold 0.2 only to detail coefficients.

name.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値
name.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds

latex: E_after=E_before+padding^2; ||e||_2^2=||delta_coeff||_2^2 only for square orthogonal transform

note.ja: 長さ17・32の小信号に3段Haar分解を適用。1標本シフトと奇数長の境界処理を分けて比較します。
note.en: Apply three-level Haar analysis to short signals of lengths 17 and 32, separating one-sample shifts from odd-length boundary handling.

title.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値
title.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds

references.formula: a_{\ell+1,k}=\frac{a_{\ell,2k}+a_{\ell,2k+1}}{\sqrt2},\quad d_{\ell+1,k}=\frac{a_{\ell,2k}-a_{\ell,2k+1}}{\sqrt2};\quad E_{\rm after}=E_{\rm before}+p_\ell^2,\quad \|e\|_2^2=\|\Delta c\|_2^2\ \text{for the square orthogonal case only}

assumptions.ja: 奇数長の各段で周期型は先頭、対称型は末尾を1点追加し、再構成時に切り戻します。詳細係数のみ閾値0.2を使用。
assumptions.en: At each odd-length level append the first sample for periodic extension or the last for symmetric extension, then crop during synthesis. Apply threshold 0.2 only to detail coefficients.

note.ja: Haarに限定し長いフィルタや画像圧縮は対象外。一般の対称拡張に正規直交性を仮定しません。シフト不変性は要求せず、シフト別差を保存します。
note.en: Limited to Haar, without longer filters or image compression. General symmetric extension is not assumed orthonormal. Shift invariance is not required; shift-dependent differences are retained.

reference_note.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。
reference_note.en: Use twelve analyses and thirty-six reconstructions. Check independent matrices, Fraction/Decimal coefficients, perfect reconstruction and squared L2 errors. Require the orthogonal error identity only at length 32; retain level-by-level padding energy at length 17.

method_note.ja: 和差フィルタ・間引き・逆ピラミッドを自作。閾値なし・hard・softの3条件を同じ解析係数から再構成します。
method_note.en: Implement pair-sum and pair-difference filters, downsampling and inverse pyramids. Reconstruct with no threshold, hard thresholding and soft thresholding from the same analysis coefficients.
